Recorded limitation: CONFIDENCE MEDIUM, AND THE REASON IS AN INFERENCE RATHER THAN A READING. At this locus the alignment leaves more than one token unread in one of the two witnesses - the differences below name them - so at least one word's letterforms were inferred from the other witness instead of being read in both. The prayer as a whole is corroborated; the individual word is not. This repository holds no page image of the 1862 for the temporal run, so the inference cannot be closed here; the 1922 Mame's pages do render, and opening the Mame page named under corroboration would settle it. Antecedent read on the 1862 text layer alone; this repository holds no page image of that book for the temporal run. Alignment over the aligned span: 24 of 42 antecedent-covered tokens exact, 15 differing only in orthography or accent as the layer renders them, 1 word-level difference(s), 0 1962 token(s) beyond the aligned span. The 1922 Tours Mame, an independent public-domain witness, carries the same prayer with 0 word-level difference(s).
